name: Kniga Mjortvyh: Poterjannye dushi
source:
Charles and his young spouse Emi move in to a house haunted by Charles' evil ancestor. Protagonist will need to come through many trials to reveal the mystery of the most hated person ever living in this town.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-may-2006-hidamari.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
查尔斯与年轻的妻子艾米搬进一栋宅邸，而那里正被查尔斯邪恶祖先的亡灵纠缠。主人公必须经受重重考验，揭开这座小镇有史以来最遭人憎恨之人的秘密。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-may-2006-hidamari.html]vndbreview[/url]]
